debug.description: Enable detailed debug logging for troubleshooting.

log_dir.description: Directory where log files are stored.

log_file.description: Name of the main log file (appended to log_dir).

api_bind_host.description: IP address or hostname the API server binds to.

api_bind_port.description: Port number for the API server.

api_workers.description: Number of worker processes to handle API requests.

auth_strategy.description: Authentication strategy: 'keystone' for real auth, 'noauth' for testing.

wsgi_config_path.description: Optional path to an external WSGI configuration file (e.g., gunicorn.conf.py).

enable_cors.description: Enable Cross-Origin Resource Sharing for browser-based clients.

cors_allowed_origins.description: List of allowed origins for CORS. Use `['*']` to allow all.

max_request_body_size.description: Maximum allowed HTTP request body size in bytes (10 MB default).

use_ssl.description: Enable TLS encryption for API endpoints.

cert_file.description: Path to the SSL certificate file (required if use_ssl=true).

key_file.description: Path to the SSL private key file (required if use_ssl=true).

ca_file.description: Path to the CA bundle for client certificate verification.

health_check_path.description: HTTP path for lightweight health-check endpoint.

upstream_connect_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for connecting to upstream services (e.g., Nova).

upstream_max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent upstream connections per host.

rate_limit_enabled.description: Enable rate limiting per client IP address.

rate_limit_requests_per_second.description: Max requests per second per client IP when rate limiting is enabled.

upstream_retry_delay.description: Delay (milliseconds) between retries when upstream calls fail.

access_log.description: Path to the access log file. Set to '-' for stdout.

pid_file.description: Path to write the process ID file.

keystone_project_domain_name.description: Domain name for the service project.

keystone_user_domain_name.description: Domain name for the service user.

keystone_project_name.description: OpenStack project (tenant) name for the service user.

keystone_password.description: Password for the service user. Required for auth.

keystone_region_name.description: OpenStack region expected for service discovery.

keystone_insecure.description: Disable SSL certificate verification (not recommended for production).

keystone_cafile.description: Path to a CA bundle file for SSL verification.

keystone_certfile.description: Client certificate file for TLS mutual auth.

keystone_keyfile.description: Client key file for TLS mutual auth.
